game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon, a canyon of scorpions: the desert nomad must handle mirage spirits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Edge Case Hunter: Find inputs like 0, empty lists, and negative numbers that break otherwise correct code.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon: a canyon of scorpions
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Week 7 examination practice: Integer division: declare resource as int, apply resource / 2, and print each result with %d. Dataset 4 starts with [-3, 0, 16, 19]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Edge Case Hunter' (Week 9 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Scorpion Canyon'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Protect the water well from mirage spirits in Scorpion Canyon: keep the edge_cases meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: edge_cases drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Edge Case Hunter – Scorpion Canyon Defense
hint: Declare before use. int resource = readInput(); creates the named game-port value; printf uses %d.
